description: Closed inventory of deployment contract shards. scripts/test:deploy-environment reads this list; order is the serial execution order and the parallel dispatch order. Adding, removing or renaming a shard is a change to the protected deployment contract and requires the corresponding shard body in the harness.

shards.name: preflight
shards.proves: inventory schema, split-host preflight rejection matrix, tampered-registry rejection, production script syntax

shards.name: prepare-images
shards.proves: image staging, registry digest binding, isolated and cross-case prepare failures

shards.name: partial-prepare
shards.proves: no-container recovery after a failed prepare, lock and state cleanup

shards.name: existing-catalog-up
shards.proves: production catalog bundle install, lock blocking, resume failure, fixture transport

shards.name: bootstrap-authority
shards.proves: registry publication as the hard barrier for bootstrap, registry-failure recovery

shards.name: bootstrap-credentials
shards.proves: credential destination rejection, orphan rejection, incomplete-phase marking

shards.name: smoke
shards.proves: hybrid transient smoke over the HTTP boundary

shards.name: measure
shards.proves: measure ledger, private-upload registry, strict entry cleanup, runtime-hash staleness

shards.name: existing-down
shards.proves: same-host lifecycle down, remote private artifact absence, Docker context teardown

shards.name: deploy-services
shards.proves: services up, compose rendering, up-phase failpoints
